short: Gave up the throne after eleven months to marry a divorced American.
full:
Edward VIII succeeded his father George V in January 1936 and was never crowned. Within months the government learned that he intended to marry Wallis Simpson, an American with one former husband still living and a divorce from a second in progress. As Supreme Governor of a Church of England that would not then remarry divorcees, ministers held that he could not do so and remain king.

Stanley Baldwin, backed by the cabinet and the dominion prime ministers, rejected both the marriage and a proposed morganatic compromise. The British press stayed silent until the first week of December. Edward signed the instrument of abdication on 10 December and it took effect the next day, when his brother became George VI. Created Duke of Windsor, he married Simpson in France in 1937, visited Hitler that October, spent the war as governor of the Bahamas, and never held public office again.
